caption: Seaweed Houses, Læsø
composition: Long half-timbered houses under thick eelgrass roofs · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From a quiet lane, long low farmhouses show white panels in a dark timber grid and enormously thick, shaggy eelgrass roofs. The island is flat and dark. It is overcast, about 14.1°C, with no rain, and the lane is empty. The roofs are seaweed, not tile. The houses are seen from the road.
